Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.
